name: Bold Enforcer
body:
Your forceful will blends with your mental focus for enhanced effects.

Prerequisite(s): Will Enforcement spell-like ability, character level 9

Benefit(s): Whenever you use will enforcement, you may apply bold foci you know on the target as part of the enforcement effect. Numerical effects of bold foci applied in this way that normally equal the penalty of the hypnotic focus follow the rules of will enforcement instead. R number of bold foci may be active in this way at a time equal to your primary ability score bonus, distributed at will across the targets. If you run out of uses, you cannot benefit further from this feat until your will enforcement ends on at least one affected target.
